info.title: shelfdrop
info.description: The API of shelfdrop: the work search, the releases of Prowlarr, the downloads, Ranger, the waiting searches. A browser signs in with the session cookie; a program sends `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Each operation names the access it needs in `x-access`: `public`, `session` (the cookie alone), `read` (the cookie or any token), `write` (the cookie or a token `write`). Every error body is `{"code", "detail", "data"}`; the codes are listed in the schema `ErrorCode`.

session.name: __Host-shelfdrop
session.description: The session of an administrator of Jellyfin, opened by `POST /api/v1/session`. A write needs the `Origin` of the host.

token.description: An access token (`sd_...`) created on the page Paramètres, API et MCP. `read` reads; `write` also downloads, places files and keeps searches waiting. 60 requests a minute; never the settings nor the tokens. No `Origin` needed.
